== Abstract ==

A cross-sectional study (survey of 304 students and staff, plus four focus groups) on the barriers and facilitators of choosing the vegetarian menu in a university cafeteria in Geneva, Switzerland, framed by the COM-B model. Main barriers: lack of vegetarian options, tastelessness, insufficient satiation. Main facilitators: the price of the vegetarian menu for students, and health and environmental benefits. The choice of a vegetarian menu was mainly driven by the attractiveness and taste of the plate.
